# Demo twin (synthetic)

Every person, organisation, address and email here is made up, generated from seed 20261123 by sim/build-demo-vault.mjs in AgentiCCells__Cell__Email. Addresses are at reserved example domains (RFC 2606). Nothing here is real mail or a real contact.

Shared by the Email Cell's demo mode and the CRM demo. Layout: orgs/ and people/ (shared), mail/ (the Email Cell's twin format v1), drafts/, and crm/ (written by the CRM's own generator). Rebuild: node sim/build-demo-vault.mjs <folder>, with the same seed.

Text and data: CC BY 4.0.
